_doc: Reverse-replay benchmark: a fixed list of hard traditional theorems, each tracked in one of 4 states. The point (per the adversarial-consensus round-2 refutation) is to DRIVE the traditional-equivalence goal with an honest red dashboard, instead of a single misleading '% done'. Four states: replayed_in_bedc (a BEDC Lean theorem reconstructs the classical statement at a declared scope), transferred_to_std (a checked equivalence/transfer to a Std/mathlib object exists), blocked_missing_carrier (buildable once paper adds a concrete carrier), blocked_forbidden_principle (structurally impossible in the 0-axiom mathlib-free core; needs an operator-scope axiom-firewalled BEDC.StdBridge layer). transferred_to_std is 0 by the mathlib-free invariant: there is no external object in-core to equate against.
